meta.task_text: Design a battery for grid energy storage: energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles of 1C cycling, discharge capacity retention >= 90% at -20C, SEI <= 550 nm after 500 cycles.

objective_breakdown: 6 adjudicable metrics: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (stage2), SEI<=500nm@100cyc (stage2), SEI<=550nm@500cyc (stage2), lowT retention>=0.90@-20C (stage2, hardest), plated=false@4C charge 45C (stage3), T_max<=333.15K@4C charge 45C (stage3, default red line). Main trade-off: ED vs rate/low-T via electrode thickness. Risk order: lowT > 4C plating > SEI@500 > ED > T_max > SEI@100.
candidate_strategy: R1: full baseline characterization of Chen2020 (1C dfn + calc-energy + aging 100/500 + lowT + 4C safety). Then opening ceiling assessment (thin CC / optimal porosity / high-transport electrolyte bounds). R2: targeted levers by gap - architecture (thicker positive, thin CC) for ED; electrolyte transport overrides + negative particle radius reduction for lowT/4C; SEI kinetics reduction (coating bridge) for SEI@500; cooling h for T_max. R3: combined best design full verification. R4: final safety re-verify. Escalate to Stage 2 material design only if ceiling assessment shows material-property bottleneck.
budget_allocation: flash run, target <=22 sims: R1=6, R2=~8, R3=6, R4=1-2, reserve ~4 for fallback. Three-strike on same cause -> questioning + plan update, no blind 4th try.
risk_and_fallback: lowT>=0.90 is highest risk (baseline Li-ion 0.4-0.8 at -20C): ladder = electrolyte transport overrides (LiFSI/ester-class, marked estimate) -> particle size down + thinner electrodes + separator porosity up -> three-strike questioning (metric reachability), honest negative result with 'if X relaxed to Y' note if unreachable. 4C plating: negative particle down, sigma/t+ up, N/P margin up, cooling up. SEI@500: SEI kinetic rate constant down (coating bridge, same-system comparison). ED: thickness up / CC down. T_max: cooling h up. Material-property gap -> Stage 2; architecture gap -> Stage 3.

note: Baseline characterization: ED 400.75 passes, SEI@100 449.1nm passes, lowT 99.4% passes; gaps = 4C plating (anode min -0.192V), T_max 354.3K > 333.15, SEI@500 777.9nm > 550｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev

candidates.name: FC-A
candidates.role: combined fast-charge/SEI candidate on Chen2020: smaller particles + high-transport electrolyte + SEI-suppressing coating bridge

llm_reason: R1 gaps: 4C plating (anode min -0.192V), T_max 354.3K (>333.15), SEI@500 777.9nm (>550). ED and lowT have ample margin (400.8 Wh/kg, 99.4%), so no ED/lowT levers needed. Plating root cause = negative surface potential <0V under 4C: reduce solid-diffusion overpotential via smaller negative particles (5.86->3.0 um), reduce electrolyte ohmic drop (sigma 0.949->1.5 S/m) and concentration polarization (t+ 0.26->0.45); smaller positive particles (5.22->4.0 um) cut charge-transfer heat and polarization. SEI@500 root cause = baseline SEI kinetics: SEI kinetic rate constant x0.2 (1e-12->2e-13 m/s) as coating-suppression bridge (Al2O3-class coating). All overrides listed before running per protocol. Sources: particle radii/SEI kinetics = estimate (domain, bridge values); sigma 1.5 S/m (15 mS/cm) and t+ 0.45 = literature-order values for advanced LiFSI-based/high-transport electrolytes, marked estimate; baseline values measured from Chen2020 set (sigma(1000)=0.949 S/m, t+=0.2594).

candidates.name: FC-B
candidates.role: fast-charge escalation on FC-A: cooling h 10->30 W/m2K (active cooling, grid-storage engineering), negative thickness 85.2->100 um (N/P margin lifts anode potential), negative particle 3.0->2.5 um (solid-diffusion overpotential down)

candidates.name: SEI-a
candidates.role: SEI-lever scan A on FC-B basis: SEI reaction exchange current density 1.5e-7 -> 1.5e-8 A/m2 (x0.1, electron-migration-limited bridge; k x0.2 kept from FC-A)

candidates.name: SEI-b
candidates.role: SEI-lever scan B on FC-B basis: SEI kinetic rate constant 2e-13 -> 1e-14 m/s (x0.01 of baseline, aggressive ec-reaction bridge)

llm_reason: FC-A 4C: anode min -0.062V (improved from -0.192 but still plated); T_max 361.1K WORSE than baseline 354.3K because higher delivered capacity (5.04Ah) raises 4C current and charge duration - heat scales with current, so T_max needs active cooling (h=30, grid-storage standard with HVAC). Plating remaining -0.062V: add N/P margin (negative 100um lifts equilibrium potential at end of charge) + negative particle 2.5um. FC-A aging500: SEI 744.5nm with k x0.2 (baseline 777.9) - k is nearly insensitive (d(log SEI)/d(log k) ~ 0.03), so the ec-reaction-limited growth is controlled elsewhere: scan i0 x0.1 (electron-migration bridge) vs k x0.01 to identify the effective lever. Sources: h=30 design choice (documented), thickness/particle = architecture estimate, i0/k = bridge estimates.

candidates.name: FC-C
candidates.role: final combined candidate: FC-A geometry (negative 85.2um - FC-B lesson: 100um negative worsened anode dip via longer electrolyte path) + stronger transport (sigma 2.0 S/m, D 2.5e-10, t+ 0.55) + negative porosity 0.30 + SEI k 2e-15 (coating bridge from scan extrapolation) + cooling h=60 (liquid-cooled grid storage)

llm_reason: Plating dip budget: FC-A min -0.062V on 85.2um geometry; FC-B (100um neg) worsened to -0.125V -> negative thickness is a strong driver of the electrolyte-phase drop in the negative; revert to 85.2um. Remaining levers to lift anode potential ~0.07V: sigma 1.5->2.0 S/m (ohmic drop ~27% lower; 20 mS/cm = LiFSI/glyme-class, estimate), D 1.77e-10->2.5e-10 (conc. polarization ~30% lower, low-viscosity solvent, estimate), t+ 0.45->0.55 (conc. pol ~18% lower, high-transference formulation, estimate), negative particle 3.0->2.5um on 85.2um geometry (solid-diffusion pol ~30% lower), negative porosity 0.25->0.30 (electrolyte tortuosity drop lower; ED cost modest). T_max: FC-B h=30 gave 347.2K with 23.6A heat; FC-C h=60 + lower polarization -> est. ~330K (verify by sim). SEI: scan gave delta(500cyc,k=1e-14)=583nm, delta~k^0.08 -> k=2e-15 extrapolates ~510nm < 550 (margin); aging100 also verified. All overrides listed before running; sigma/D/t+ = literature-order estimates for advanced LiFSI-based low-viscosity electrolytes (domain experience, no precise source), particle/porosity/thickness = architecture estimates, SEI k = coating bridge estimate (aggressive x0.002, artificial-SEI-class suppression), h=60 = liquid-cooled grid-storage design choice (documented).
